segment_contamination_dimensions: Material-specific sibling segments: 'FRP Cabin' (ID 121149) and 'FRP Portable Security Cabin' (ID 145135) are direct siblings covering the FRP/fiberglass sub-segment — names that are exact matches to these sibling MCAT names are discarded to avoid collision (e.g., 'FRP Cabin' and 'FRP Portable Security Cabin' as standalone names are excluded from enhanced name candidates).

Use-case-specific sibling segments: siblings 'Security Cabins' (ID 42755), 'Portable Security Cabins' (ID 135705), and 'Prefabricated Security Cabin' (ID 181975) carve out the security-only sub-segment — enhanced names that exclusively target security guard buyers without referencing the GRP/FRP material differentiator are discarded, as they would collide with these siblings' buyer segments.

Material-alternative sibling segments: 'MS Porta Cabin' (ID 150852), 'Wooden Cabins' (ID 43789), 'PUF Cabin' (ID 167809), 'PVC Portable Cabin' (ID 181546), 'GI Portable Cabin' (ID 185338), and 'Aluminium Office Cabins' (ID 185339) serve buyers of non-GRP material cabins — any enhanced name or alt name implying MS, steel, wood, PUF, PVC, GI, or aluminium construction is discarded as it attracts an incompatible buyer segment.

Eco/log cabin sibling segments: 'Eco Portable Cabins' (ID 135966) and 'Portable Log Cabins' (ID 150362) target nature/sustainability-oriented buyers — names emphasising eco, log, or natural material framing are discarded as they attract a distinct buyer persona not served by GRP Cabin.
